sources.note: Town of Danville, 2025 Annual Town Report, elected officers tables (pp. 10-12): Moderator Ernest Tobias Balivet (term to 2026).

Town of Danville, DRAFT Annual Town Meeting minutes, March 3, 2026: Balivet was re-elected Moderator. This record corrects the batch-6 build, which seated Eric Bach as moderator on a cited 'Results of Officers Elected' document that does not exist; Bach's moderator membership is removed in this sweep (his selectboard and JP records are verified and stand).
Town of Danville, 2025 Annual Town Report, elected officers tables (pp. 10-12): Listers J. Timothy Ide (term to 2028), John Blackmore (2027), and Marcia Pettigrew (2026).

Town of Danville, DRAFT Annual Town Meeting minutes, March 3, 2026: Pettigrew was re-elected lister (new term to 2029). This corrects the batch-6 build, which seated two listers who appear in no Danville document (their memberships are removed) and carried the post at two seats; the post is corrected to three seats.
Town of Danville, 2025 Annual Town Report, elected officers tables (pp. 10-12): Collector of Delinquent Taxes Edward Ledo (term to 2026).

Town of Danville, 2026 Annual Town Meeting Warning (January 15, 2026) and DRAFT minutes, March 3, 2026: the warning carries a Delinquent Tax Collector article and the minutes record Ed Ledo re-elected. The batch-6 build created no DTC post for Danville; it is created here.
